question: In October 2020, the Haryana Government launched a ______ under the Jal Jeevan Mission scheme.

options.text: mobile app to test pH level in water
training programme to test water salinity

solution:
The correct answer is a __**mobile water testing laboratory**.__**​**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** Key Points__**

 
• In October 2020, the Haryana government has launched a mobile water testing laboratory under the Jal Jeevan Mission scheme.
 
• It is fully equipped with a multi-parameter system containing analysers, sensors, probes and instruments meant for assessing water quality.
 
• Water quality in Haryana is mainly affected by constituents like total dissolved solids, fluoride, nitrate, iron and alkalinity.
 
• This testing lab is GPS-enabled for location tracking.
